liturgicalName: The Most Holy Body and Blood of Christ (Corpus Christi)
keyVerseDR: "I am the living bread which came down from heaven." (Jn 6:51 DR)

level1.title: Bread from Heaven
level1.story: Jesus said, "I am the living bread from heaven." Whoever eats this bread will live forever. At Mass, Jesus gives us Himself!
level1.keyLine: Jesus is the Bread of Life.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say He is?
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are truly here. Amen.

level2.title: The Living Bread
level2.story: Jesus said, "I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever." The people argued, "How can this man give us His flesh to eat?" Jesus said, "My flesh is true food, and My blood is true drink." Whoever eats His flesh and drinks His blood remains in Him, and He in them. At every Mass, Jesus gives us His Body and Blood in Holy Communion.
level2.keyLine: I am the living bread which came down from heaven.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does the Church mean by Real Presence?
How can you prepare for Holy Communion?
level2.prayer: Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament, I adore You. Amen.

activity.title: Before the tabernacle
activity.intro: Jesus is truly present in the Eucharist. Write a prayer of adoration.
starters: Jesus, I believe You are here...
Thank You for the Bread of Life...
